feedAndExecutionAnalysis.continuousOrderBooks: An active engine starts a CCXT Pro watch_order_book loop for each discovered/configured symbol per selected venue. Changed books trigger scan evaluation; reconnect uses bounded exponential backoff. This is not every symbol on every exchange.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.restOrderBooks: Not continuously streamed by the engine. REST is used for preflight and periodic server-time RTT samples; the public scanner is a separate REST snapshot flow.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.crossVenuePricing: The hub compares both buy/sell directions for common symbols, estimates depth-aware expected and worst-case net PnL, and ranks candidates before rechecking the selected opportunity.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.liveExecutor: A selected opportunity still requires fresh books, depth, balances, fees, permission, private-stream health, latency, risk, and certified IOC routes. Cross-venue execution uses simultaneous IOC limit orders with pre-funded inventory. Unmatched fills can halt the engine for review.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.profitTarget: A session stop threshold based on realized PnL; it is not an assurance or guarantee of attaining that amount.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.browser: The authenticated frontend polls engine state while a session is active and reads recent journal entries. It does not own exchange sockets or display every depth delta.
feedAndExecutionAnalysis.persistency: Per-user SQLite journal stores trades and opportunities. Runtime sockets/session state are not persistent across service restarts and the live engine does not auto-resume.
